digest.component_or_area: plan-review gate / evidence contract / attestation framework
propositions: Operator-attested evidence lacks enforced measurement provenance fields (environment, principal, privilege posture, instrument type) allowing claims to pass gates despite measurements taken in wrong context or under non-production-equivalent conditions.

Live world measurements under broader privilege than production (e.g., bedrock:* identity vs scoped IAM) are structurally unable to fail, making their success carry zero information about production behavior.

Policy simulators answer the question asked (does policy permit named action) rather than the question that matters (which action does the service actually check), leading to confident but incorrect authorization conclusions.

Plans asserting unchanged behavior across substrate/route/provider swaps without citing the resolution path files that consume swapped configuration remain invisible to review despite full repo reachability of ground truth.

A deterministic criterion now flags [operator-attested] evidence lacking provenance fields; advisory-tier criterion judges provenance declarations against repo facts for contradictions between plan context and IaC/config state.
